text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training
with Kitasan Black—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I stayed for a bit
of voluntary training after this?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it...
It feels like I haven't quite run enough.

Where Kitasan Black was looking, Satono Diamond
could still be seen running silently and intently.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't let Dia-chan beat me either,
so...!
choice_data_list: Let's keep our pace so we don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can't let Dia-chan beat me either,
so...!
choice_data_list: Let's keep our pace so we don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even with a festival shrine, when everyone carries it together,
you feel more strength welling up than usual—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, Trainer,
there's no doubt we'll get tons of results!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Kitasan Black and I
powered through an intense extra training session.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Well...
I know moderation is important, but still...
choice_data_list: In return, there's something I want to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: I wanted your opinion on the new menu...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
!!
Y-Yes! Anything for the sake of my running!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... With this combination,
it certainly feels like we can improve the lacking areas...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Right here, I'd like to increase
the proportion of strength training a bit.
See, in the mock race the other day—

And so, by holding a meeting with Kitasan Black,
we put together an effective training menu.
